scope: 单张角色插画的作品级提取。原始发表来源、署名及制作工艺未核验。

references.R1: 用户上传的 ART OF MISSING 角色群像插画，1486×2010 WebP。 归档文件 reference.webp。
references.R1-top: 左上两行手写标题及小说明、右上灰色大胸像与小角色。
references.R1-hero: 前景中央抱着珊瑚红大铅笔的浅色猫角。
references.R1-mid: 画架、桌面、收纳箱、盆栽，以及抱、蹲、探头的小角色。
references.R1-floor: 桌下、角色脚下、纸片和彩笔散布的地面区域。

slots.workbench: 用来组织道具及互动的中景工作区
slots.anchor: 位于中后层的大体量场景物
slots.sidekicks: 参与各自微动作的配角或拟人化物件
slots.props: 向前景及边缘散落的主题物件
slots.headline: 左上留白内的简短标题

lettered.en: the illustration calls for a heading

rules.zh: 在暖白纸色底上以黑色细轮廓和平涂画出圆润角色群像，让{{hero}}、{{workbench}}与{{anchor}}构成有前后叠压的场景。
rules.en: Create a rounded character ensemble on warm off-white with fine black outlines and flat fills. Layer {{hero}}, {{workbench}} and {{anchor}} through overlap.
rules.check: 缩图可读到主角、工作区和后景大形三层。

rules.zh: 以暖白和低饱和灰褐为底，薄荷蓝、橄榄绿和褪珊瑚红分隔物件；把蛋黄黄集中在主角的眼睛与少量配角点缀。
rules.en: Base the palette on warm off-white and muted gray-brown; use pale mint-blue, olive and faded coral to separate objects. Concentrate egg-yolk yellow in the hero's eyes and a few minor accents.
rules.check: 眼睛与互动工具先读，彩色道具不会平均抢焦。

rules.zh: 角色和道具主体保持平涂，叠压间隙、脚底和接触地面的少数区域用轮廓硬朗的小块纯黑影。
rules.en: Keep figures and props flat-colored, adding small hard-edged solid black shapes in a few overlaps and ground contacts.
rules.check: 阴影清楚锚定物件，面部或背景没有写实光效。

rules.zh: 保持上方和左侧大块留白，让{{anchor}}居中偏右，{{workbench}}过渡到中段，{{hero}}坐在下部偏中。让{{props}}沿底部疏散。
rules.en: Reserve broad upper and left-side breathing room, place {{anchor}} off-center to the right, transition through {{workbench}} in the middle, and seat {{hero}} near the lower center. Scatter {{props}} loosely along the bottom.
rules.check: 上疏下密，场景靠遮挡与地面接触建立深度。

rules.zh: 让{{hero}}采用大头、短肢、圆手、简洁五官的比例，与偏大的手持工具发生清楚接触；{{sidekicks}}保持较小尺度。
rules.en: Give {{hero}} a large head, short limbs, rounded hands and simple features, with a clear grip on a disproportionately large tool. Keep {{sidekicks}} smaller.
rules.check: 主角轮廓、手与工具的接触、次级角色的尺度可辨。

rules.zh: 用有弹性的近黑细线围合大形，内部只用必要短线画衣褶、接缝、转折和表情。道具用几何形，角色肢体用圆曲线。
rules.en: Enclose major shapes with pliant thin near-black lines. Use short interior marks only for folds, seams, turns and expression. Make props geometric and limbs rounded.
rules.check: 缩图仍有清楚轮廓，放大不见无用复线。

rules.zh: 保持角色轮廓、色块和接触影的明确硬边；通过遮挡、留缺与裁切区别前后，避免整体柔化。
rules.en: Keep character outlines, fills and contact shadows crisp. Use occlusion, gaps and cropped forms to distinguish depth, avoiding overall softening.
rules.check: 主要色块边界完整，局部缺口有前景遮挡依据。

rules.zh: 主角眼睛、手与道具接触点画清楚，次级道具保留功能特征，后景大色面减少细节。
rules.en: Resolve the hero's eyes, hands and tool contacts, retain functional cues on secondary props, and simplify broad background shapes.
rules.check: 精细处与叙事动作相符，远端装饰不过密。

rules.zh: 以少量平涂破边、短排线、简化图案和纯黑影表示纸、木、布或硬表面；大色面保持干净。
rules.en: Suggest paper, wood, cloth or hard surfaces with a few flat broken color marks, short hatches, simple patterns and solid black shapes. Leave broad fills clean.
rules.check: 材质记号有区域归属，背景无明显颗粒或照片质感。

rules.zh: 让{{sidekicks}}通过各自的一件道具或明显动作参与同一个场景。用眼睛、探头或姿势轻度拟人化一部分物件。
rules.en: Give {{sidekicks}} one distinct action or prop apiece within the same shared setting. Lightly personify selected objects through eyes, peeking poses or gestures.
rules.check: 可以指出每组角色正在做什么，普通物件仍能辨认。

rules.zh: 把细节集中在{{workbench}}的交接处和主角手边。下缘零星道具作停顿，上方与边缘保留连续暖白。
rules.en: Concentrate details around joins in {{workbench}} and the hero's hands. Leave scattered small pauses along the bottom and continuous warm off-white around the top and edges.
rules.check: 密集区聚而不糊，边缘仍有连续留白。

rules.zh: 让观众先看前景{{hero}}的眼睛与动作，再沿道具看向中后层。带题头时，将{{headline}}放在左上空处，用松弛手写字。
rules.en: Draw the eye first to the eyes and gesture of {{hero}}, then upward through props. When lettered, place {{headline}} in the upper-left gap in loose hand lettering.
rules.check: 缩图先读大眼和主动作，题头、插画彼此留边。

rules.zh: 用圆润表情对照有棱角的工作道具，用安静的暖白对照密集的小动作，让场景有忙碌而亲切的气氛。
rules.en: Contrast rounded expressions with angular workshop props, and quiet warm-white space with clustered little actions, for a busy yet friendly mood.
rules.check: 读者既能感到活动发生，也能区分最重要的动作。
